tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List HIPROFEET services
tools.description: List every service HIPROFEET offers, with pricing in Naira, delivery timeline, and a short description. Use this to answer questions about what HIPROFEET sells or to recommend a fitting service.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter matched against service name, tag, or id.

tools.name: get_service
tools.title: Get HIPROFEET service details
tools.description: Get full details for a single HIPROFEET service by id: the problem it solves, how it helps, what's included, price, timeline, and the order URL.

service_id.description: The service id, e.g. 'fb', 'ig', 'tt', 'website', 'followers', 'consultant'. Use list_services to discover ids.
